entities.summary: Joseph Kossivi Ahiator is an African politician and Ghanaian artist known for his temple mural paintings in Bénin, Ghana, and Togo. He is a member of the National Democratic Congress (NDC) and a former Member of Parliament for the Ketu South Constituency in the Volta Region of Ghana.
